decisive_items: sudden onset of cramping right flank pain radiating to the groin
a large retroperitoneal hemorrhage surrounding the right kidney extending into the pelvis
heterogeneous echogenicity around the right renal parenchyma
response.rationale: The combination of sudden onset flank pain, tenderness at the renal angle, and imaging findings of a retroperitoneal hemorrhage and heterogeneous echogenicity around the renal parenchyma most strongly supports spontaneous renal hemorrhage.

rejected.why: Imaging findings suggest a hemorrhage rather than an infarction.
